verdicts.reason: Both 320x50 banners blow the legal disclaimer up into a large right-hand text block that competes with the headline, and both put the SOLSTICE wordmark under the headline. A also crowds the pills: HONEY ROSEMARY and CUCUMBER MINT touch or overlap, a tiny pill is jammed under the button, illegible text sits at the top left, and the subhead is gone. B keeps the subhead, but it is unreadably small; its pills are scattered across three spots, and the BLOOD ORANGE pill is crammed against the legal block. B is slightly less broken because its pills don't collide.
